purpose: Repository-native coordination protocol in which persistent agent identities retrieve immutable jobs from their workspace and submit evidence-backed results for MASTER verification without HUMAN prompt transport.

ownership.RULE: Ownership controls SAFOR protocol writes only; actual provider permissions remain authoritative and no JSON grants rights.

identityContract.identityChangePolicy: Changing an immutable identity field requires explicit HUMAN re-identification and a new identityRevision before further job claims.

activationContract.trigger: HUMAN, automation or another host-supported activation mechanism must activate the chat/agent runtime.
activationContract.promptTransportRule: The HUMAN must not need to copy the job contract into the agent chat after initial identity bootstrap.

eligibleWhen: job is discoverable through the current MASTER-owned inbox index
masterJobState.lifecycleStatus is claimable for the current dispatch (READY or REWORK_READY)
job.provenance.mandateRef and job.authorization.authorityBasis.mandateRef resolve to the same active mandate
actual provider rights cover every operation allowed by job.authorization
job.scheduling.dispatchWaveRef refers to an active MASTER dispatch wave
all job.scheduling.resourceLeaseRefs are ACTIVE and assigned to this job/agent
all mutating job.workspace.gitWorkspaces exist on the declared dedicated branches at declared immutable base commits
all mandatory job.skills are readable at their pinned blob identities
job.roleContract role is compatible with the persistent identity and current assignment
claimProtocol.atomicity: Claim is written through optimistic concurrency on agents/{agentId}/state.json using the provider-observed current revision/blob identity. Concurrent stale claims must fail and reconcile.
claimProtocol.masterObservation: A claim is not authoritative for orchestration until MASTER reads back the agent state and advances master/jobs/{jobId}.json from READY to CLAIMED.

executionContract.jobChangePolicy: Changed scope or mandate produces a new dispatchRevision or a superseding job; the agent never silently mutates its inbox contract.
executionContract.jobHumanProjectionRule: The Markdown job view is derived from the authoritative JSON and may not expand scope, role, skills, authorization or outputs.

resultProtocol.submission: Agent writes the machine-readable outbox result, the mandatory HUMAN-readable Markdown result, referenced evidence and Git trace, then sets its local state to RESULT_SUBMITTED.
resultProtocol.notAcceptance: Agent result is a claim of work performed, never authoritative acceptance.
resultProtocol.acceptanceAuthority: Only MASTER may mark VERIFIED/ACCEPTED after required evidence, review and gates are satisfied.

humanReadableContract.rule: Every job produces a HUMAN-readable result, including read-only jobs. The machine JSON must pin the Markdown blob identity.

gitTraceContract.mutatingJobs: Every repository mutation must be attributable to the job through dedicated branch, immutable base commit, result commit SHA(s), changed paths and provider readback.
gitTraceContract.readOnlyJobs: A read-only job may have an empty work-repository gitTrace, but its HUMAN-readable and machine-readable outbox results still persist in the Git-backed control repository.
gitTraceContract.verification: MASTER reads back every claimed commit/branch/change request before result verification.

discoveryProtocol.purpose: Provide a deterministic fixed read target for job discovery so an agent never depends on repository directory enumeration or HUMAN prompt transport.
discoveryProtocol.entrySelection: Read entries in stored order and consider only AVAILABLE or REWORK_AVAILABLE entries for the active identity revision.
discoveryProtocol.staleIndexRule: The index is only a discovery projection. If an entry conflicts with the job contract or MASTER job state, the authoritative artifacts win and the agent must not claim from the stale entry.
discoveryProtocol.updateRule: MASTER updates the index with revision-controlled writes and provider readback whenever jobs become discoverable, withdrawn, superseded or accepted.

humanJobContract.publicationRule: MASTER writes JSON and Markdown, verifies both by provider readback, then and only then marks the job READY and exposes it through inbox/index.json.
